name: BloodBowl_Card
cardText: Foul Appearance, Loner (4+), Monstrous Mouth, Nerves of Steel, On the Ball, Plague Ridden
specialRules: Quick Bite: Once per game, if Guffle is Marking an opposition player who catches the ball, he may immediately make an Armour Roll against that player. If the target’s Armour is broken, Guffle immediately gains possession of the ball. No Turnover is caused as a result of using this special rule.
